boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.target: 强度 %d 持续 %d 回合

entries.source:
Throw a cloud of blinding dust in a radius %d cone. Enemies within will be blinded, as well as having their accuracy reduced by %d and movement speed decreased by %d%% for %d turns.
		The chance to inflict these effects increase with your Accuracy.
entries.target:
撒出致盲粉，致盲前方 %d 格锥形范围内的敌人。受影响的敌人命中减少 %d，移动速度减少 %d%%，持续 %d 回合。
		效果成功率受命中加成。

entries.source: The target is walking on slime. Decreasing movement speed by 20% and dealing 20 slime damage to any creatures attacking it.
entries.target: 目标行走在史莱姆上。减少 20% 移动速度并对任何攻击它的目标造成 20 点史莱姆伤害。

entries.source: I did not mean to intrude. I shall leave now.
entries.target: 我无意闯入这里，我会离开的。

entries.source: deals %d temporal damage and slows enemies in radius 6 of the target by %d%% based on Magic
entries.target: 造成%d时空伤害，并使6码范围内的敌人减速%d%%（基于魔法）。

entries.source: I don't take unsolicited messages from... stars.
entries.target: 我不接受来自……恒星的不请自来的消息。

entries.source: Legend tells of a blade, shining bright as a star. Forged from a material fallen from the skies, it glows.
entries.target: 传说之刃，闪耀如星。由取自陨石的材料锻造而成，它散发着光芒。

entries.source: Upon defeat, Ak'Gishil collapsed into this tiny rift. How it remains stable, you are unsure. If you focus, you think you can call forth a sword from it.
entries.target: 在击败阿克·吉希尔后，它留下了这个小巧的裂隙。你无从知道，它是如何保持这样的稳定状态。冥冥中你感受到，你能从这个裂隙中召唤出一把剑。

entries.source: Flames swirl on the icy surface of this orb.
entries.target: 火焰在覆满了冰霜的水晶球上旋转。

entries.source: Extract magical gems from metal weapons and armours. At this skill level you can work with metals of at maximum tier %d.
entries.target: 从金属武器或护甲中提取魔法宝石。在当前技能等级下，你最多只能从材质等级 %d 的金属装备中提取物品。

entries.source: You must be grappling something to use this talent.
entries.target: 你必须处于抓取中才能使用这个技能。

entries.source: Back in my day, we didn't need to go changing our staves around willy-nilly. We picked an element and stuck with it, by the gods.
entries.target: 在我们那个年代，谁会随随便便把法杖形态调来调去。我们选定一种元素就一直用到底，诸神在上。

entries.source: You were sent to the Charred Scar at the heart of which lies a huge volcano. In the Age of Pyre it destroyed the old Sher'Tul ruins that stood there, absorbing much of their latent magic.
entries.target: 你被送到了灼烧之痕，其中心是一座巨大的火山——烈火纪元时，喷发的火山摧毁了当时矗立于此的古老夏·图尔遗址，并吸收了其中潜藏的大量魔法。

entries.source: Mages sometimes have funny ideas. Archmage Varil once learned how to handle a sword and found he preferred wielding it instead of his staff.
entries.target: 法师总是时不时冒出古怪的点子。大法师沃利尔曾学会了怎样擎起一柄剑，同时发现自己对耍剑比玩法杖更感冒。

entries.source:
For the next %d turns you may not create minor anomalies.  You do not regain Paradox or lose the spell you're casting if a random anomaly would normally occur.
		This spell has no effect on major anomalies.
entries.target:
接下来的 %d 回合中，你不会产生微小异变。  当随机异变正常发生时，不会导致你获得紊乱值或者施法失败。
		这个技能对重大异变没有影响。

entries.source: They can spawn oozes to protect and attack from a distance while also being adept at harnessing the power of mindstars and psiblades.
entries.target: 他们能制造软泥怪，来保护自己或远距离攻击对方，同时也能利用灵晶和心灵利刃来强化自己。

entries.source: #F53CBE#You are having trouble focusing on your prey!
entries.target: #F53CBE#你无法集中注意力在你的目标身上！

entries.source:
Fire three shots in quick succession at a vulnerable point on the target (usually the head).
		Each shot deals %d%% Ranged damage and will try to stun or increase the target's stun duration by 1.
		These shots will bypass other enemies between you and your target.
		The chance to stun increases with your Accuracy.
entries.target:
对敌人的脆弱部位（通常是头部）迅速地连射三次。
		每次射击造成 %d%% 远程伤害并试图震慑目标或增加震慑的持续时间 1 回合。
		这些射击将会穿过你和目标间的其他敌人。
		受命中影响，震慑几率增加。

entries.source:
Call upon the forces of nature to regenerate your body for %d life every turn for 10 turns.
		The life healed increases with Spellpower.
entries.target:
召唤自然的力量治愈你的身体，每回合回复 %d 生命值持续 10 回合。
		治疗量受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Full and total control over your undead army.
entries.target: 完全控制你的不死军团。

entries.source: #ORCHID#%s instinctively hardens %s skin and ignores the attack!#LAST#
entries.target: #ORCHID#%s本能地硬化%s皮肤，无视了这次攻击！#LAST#

entries.source: The simplest of belts, worn for centuries by Nessilla Tantaelen as she tended to her people and forests. Some of her wisdom and power have settled permanently into its fibers.
entries.target: 最朴素的腰带，被奈希拉·坦泰兰在照料她的人民和森林期间穿戴了几个世纪。这条腰带永久的保存了她的部分智慧和力量。

entries.source: Casts lasers on spellcast when worn or imbued.
entries.target: 当装备或镶嵌时，施放法术时附加激光。

entries.source:
Make a melee attack for %d%% damage and then attempt to grapple a target up to one size category larger than yourself for %d turns. A grappled opponent will be unable to move, take %d damage each turn, and %d%% of the damage you receive from any source will be redirected to them as physical damage.
		Any movement from the target or you will break the grapple. Maintaining a grapple drains %d stamina per turn.
		You may only grapple a single target at a time, and using any targeted unarmed talent on a target that you're not grappling will break the grapple.
entries.target:
对目标造成 %d%% 武器伤害并抓取目标（可抓取目标的身材最多比你大 1 级）持续 %d 回合。1 个被钳住的对手将无法移动，每回合受到 %d 伤害，同时你受到的伤害的 %d%% 将转移至它身上。
		任何目标或你的移动将会打破抓取。维持抓取每回合消耗 %d 体力。
		同时你只能抓取 1 个目标，并且对任意 1 个你没有抓取的目标使用非抓取徒手技能均会打破抓取。

entries.source: While dual-wielding you have a %d%% chance of completely parrying melee attacks made against you.
entries.target: 双持时你有 %d%% 几率格挡近战攻击。

entries.source: %s is caught in the static field!
They do not use the forbidden arcane arts practised by the mages of old - such perverters of nature have been shunned or actively hunted down since the Spellblaze.
entries.target: 他们不使用那些远古的被禁止的法术，那些法术自从魔法大爆炸之后就被人们禁止和追捕。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Finally, the master of the arena comes into the gates!
#LIGHT_GREEN#The public roars with excitement as he faces you with confidence!*
I applaud you, @playerdescriptor.race@! You have fought with might and courage!
And now...the time for the final showdown!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master assumes a fighting stance. The audience cheers!*
Like you, I started from nowhere. I won't underestimate someone with such potential.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master smirks, you assume your fighting stance as well, and the
#LIGHT_GREEN#audience cheers you as well, making the excitement grow inside you*
Can you hear it, the public cheering? That's what this is about.
Pursue glory with all your might, @playerdescriptor.race@!!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master steps forward into the sand*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*终于，竞技场主宰穿过大门，步入场中！
#LIGHT_GREEN#他自信地与你对峙，观众兴奋地咆哮起来！*
值得称赞，@playerdescriptor.race@！你凭力量与勇气一路奋战至此！
现在……最终对决的时刻到了！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰摆出战斗架势。观众放声欢呼！*
和你一样，我也曾从一无所有起步。我不会低估像你这样潜力非凡的人。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰得意一笑；你也摆出战斗架势，
#LIGHT_GREEN#观众同样为你欢呼，令你心中的激动愈发高涨*
听见了吗？观众正在欢呼。这才是竞技场的意义。
用尽全力追逐荣耀吧，@playerdescriptor.race@！！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰向前踏入沙场*

entries.source: Any time you do not have an opponent in a square adjacent to you, you gain %0.1f Stamina regeneration. At talent level 3 or more, you also gain an equal amount of life regen when Breathing Room is active.
entries.target: 当没有敌人与你相邻的时候，你获得 %0.1f 体力回复。技能等级 3 及以后，这个技能带给你等量的生命回复。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: The power of the Spellblaze still burns here. -10% resistance to fire, arcane and blight damage, but +10% cold resistance. WARNING: The powerful magic here reflects teleportation magic!
entries.target: 地图效果 : 魔法大爆炸的火焰仍在燃烧，-10% 火焰、枯萎、奥术抗性 , +10% 寒冷抗性。警告：强大的魔法能量可能干扰传送法术！

entries.source: Whispers seem to ceaselessly emanate from this writhing mass of black tentacles, murmuring unspeakable horrors into the ears of any unfortunate enough to hear them.
entries.target: 从这团扭动的黑色触须中似乎不停地传出耳语，向任何不幸听到的人低语着难以言喻的恐怖。

entries.source:
Conjure a shield of ice around you that can absorb a total of %d damage.
		Anytime it does it retaliates by sending a bolt of ice at the attacker, dealing %0.2f cold damage (this can only happen once per turn per creature).
		When you are above 1 life it only affects 66.6%% of the damage, letting through the rest.
		When you are under 1 life it affects 100%% of the damage and also reduces the damage of critical hits by %d%%.
		10 turns after leaving combat the shield will consume its mana and soul cost again to fully regenerate if needed. if that cost can not be matched, it unsustains.
		The shield strength will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
使用冰块在你的身边形成一道护盾，吸收最多 %d 点伤害。
		每当其受到伤害，它会对攻击者发射一团冰球，造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害（每个生物每回合最多触发一次）
		当你的生命值在 1 以上的时候，护盾只吸收 66.6%% 的伤害。
		当你的生命值在 1 以下时，护盾吸收 100%% 伤害，还会降低你受到的暴击伤害 %d%%。
		当你脱离战斗 10 回合后，护盾将会试图消耗魔法和灵魂，将其恢复到满。如果不能满足这一条件，护盾会解除。
		护盾强度受法术强度加成。
通用 增加精神抗性穿透
技能（精神）命中后释放：%s (%d%% 几率等级 %d)。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Additional Melee Damage#LAST#
Each time you strike a creature with a melee attack, you will deal additional damage or other effects.
entries.target:
#GOLD#近战附加伤害#LAST#
每次你近战击中其他生物，都会造成这些额外伤害或附加效果。

entries.source: Sure... if you prefer to think about it this way. We are all part of The Way anyway.
entries.target: 啊……如果你愿意这么想也没问题。反正，我们都是维网的一份子。

entries.source: The target is redirecting energy, adding %d gravity damage to their attacks.%s
entries.target: 目标正在调度能量，每次攻击额外造成 %d 重力伤害。%s

entries.source:
You empathy with your shadows causes the line between you and your shadows to blur.
		You lose %d%% light resistance, but gain %d%% darkness resistance and affinity. You also gain %0.2f%% all resistance for each shadow in your party.
entries.target:
你与阴影之间的共鸣，使彼此的界限逐渐模糊。
		你的光系伤害抗性变化 %d%%，并获得 %d%% 暗影伤害抗性和伤害亲和。你的队伍里每有一个阴影，就获得 %0.2f%% 所有伤害抗性。

entries.source: You failed to protect her when escorting her out of the crypt.
entries.target: 你没能成功地将她护送出这个地宫。
